scope: Additive primary-source post-2025 Electro Boots L1-27 aura DPS and self-healing table; pulse arithmetic and target geometry remain partial.
game_version: Supercell 2025-01-22 announcement for the February 2025 balance update. Current September 2026 executable and later unlisted changes are unverified.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese table gives post-nerf aura DPS at every level and self-healing per second, including unchanged L1-14 rows and reduced L15-27 rows.
All 27 pairs match the retained normalized catalogue fields.
sources.limitations: No radius, pulse interval, per-pulse damage, fractional rounding, healing accumulation, target classes or activation/death tick order is specified.

derivations.result: Every retained auraDps and selfHealingPerSecond value matches the official post-nerf table; L1-14 healing is the printed pre-change value marked unchanged, L15-27 healing is the printed post-change value.
derivations.method: Transcribe the official after-change aura column and resolved after-change healing column level by level, then compare to immutable normalized source_fields.stats. Keep per-pulse damage, cadence and radius separate.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the retained auraDamagePerHit as an exact current hit value
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table prints DPS only; fractional per-hit labels, cadence and accumulation are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply healing on every fixed tick by dividing the per-second value by 100
rejected_inferences.reason: The published rate has no fractional accumulator, rounding or first-heal phase contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Damage all entities inside a five-tile center-to-center circle
rejected_inferences.reason: The level table omits radius, hitbox geometry and target eligibility.

rejected_inferences.rule: Enable Electro Boots passive aura in Core
rejected_inferences.reason: Target selection, pulse phase, fractional damage/heal arithmetic and same-tick death ordering remain unsourced.

items: radius and pulse interval continuity, target classes and boundary geometry
per-pulse damage rounding or accumulation and self-heal integer arithmetic
deployment and first-pulse/heal ticks, simultaneous damage and death order
interaction with invisible targets, Walls, Pets and second Equipment
Viewer aura overlay, snapshot, replay and RL future-influencing state

conclusion: Electro Boots L1-27 aura DPS and self-healing rates match an official post-nerf level table. Exact pulse and heal arithmetic, geometry and tick order remain partial, so no combat aura is enabled.
